name: Neustrelitz (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Neustrelitz (a griffin and a bull's head on red and yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Neustrelitz; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Neustrelitz arms — griffin and bull's head
